count_definition.eligibility_pop: PREREG §2 treatment rows: 'every published pick (selected_rank not null) on a non-excluded night, 2026-04-01..2026-09-10, that has a lane-plan ladder in public_payload_json' (here: a valid swing_trading/L3 target), minus §2 exclusion bullets that apply pre-maturity: manual-run nights (exclusions_v001.json, 5 dates) and the non-session run 2026-04-03 found by the registrar; picks 'whose L3 is already on the wrong side of the actual pick-night close ("hit at publication") -> excluded as invalid targets, counted separately'; a night is counted eligible if >=1 usable pick remains ('the night survives if >=1 pick remains').
count_definition.maturity: PREREG §5: 'Eligible night = non-excluded pick night whose endpoint window has matured in the pinned price freeze.' Here computed directly from the pinned manifest_prices_v001 trading-session calendar (last session 2026-09-10): a night matures for a given endpoint when trading_date's session index + the endpoint's window (E1=40, E2=5 trading sessions) falls on or before the freeze's last session. §5 also states: 'nights whose endpoint window has not matured in the pinned price freeze -> excluded and counted; right-censoring is never graded as a non-touch.'
count_definition.contribution: A mature, eligible night contributes if it additionally clears PREREG §2's remaining exclusion: 'delisted / missing-bar symbols -> dropped and counted; a night is dropped if > 25% of its picks are missing bars' (checked here as missing daily bars anywhere inside the endpoint's forward window, per usable pick's symbol).
